testC_stagingCannotModifyProduction.mechanism: Strict URL isolation & separate credentials in environment templates. Staging has no access to production Supabase service key or database URL.

testD_developmentCannotModifyProduction.mechanism: Local development client defaults to local/placeholder Supabase URL unless explicitly provided with production keys; RLS and anon key restrict write mutations.

testE_productionCannotModifyStaging.mechanism: Production container holds only production URL and keys; completely partitioned from staging.

testF_authIsolation.mechanism: Supabase projects use distinct JWT secrets (GoTrue); tokens minted by staging Supabase are invalid on production and vice versa.

sentinelIsolationPlan.protocol: Once staging Supabase project is provisioned by human administrator, apply migrations and insert sentinel record: { id: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', name: 'STAGING_SENTINEL_W002' } into public.states or public.districts, and query production Supabase to verify it returns 404/empty.
